title: We Need To Talk About Nvidia, CoreWeave and Nebius Before Tomorrow
creator: Couch Investor
source_note: Detailed summary generated from video captions; note: captions garble several names and figures in the Nvidia timeline in places
summary: Couch Investor covers the Nvidia scandal, CoreWeave's earnings and a Nebius preview ahead of Thursday's report. On Nvidia, the timeline: an October 2025 US and Singapore probe into a Singapore-based customer over possible export-control evasion, unverified claims of $7.5 billion and around 240,000 chips moved to Chinese firms, Jensen Huang admitting to an affair, a board probe, and Jensen due before Congress after Nvidia's 17 November earnings. He stresses the affair itself is not what could hurt Nvidia; the risk is whether anyone at Nvidia knew about possible export evasion. Fundamentally, he says nothing has changed: Nvidia trades at a trailing P/E of 21.9 and forward 14.3, is fast-growing, very profitable and cheap, with about 91% revenue growth expected next quarter. He reiterates his NVDA BUY. CoreWeave reported an excellent quarter: revenue up 168% year on year, a $132.5 billion backlog up 138%, adjusted EBITDA of $2.26 billion at a 62% margin, though still a GAAP net loss and interest expense up 30% to about $1.1 billion. He highlights the renewal of 300,000 paid-off GPUs in 2027-28, worth about $10 billion of annualised revenue with no new capex. He reiterates his CRWV BUY. On Nebius, he expects it to crush Thursday's earnings, with revenue expected up 520% year on year and 2027 annual recurring revenue possibly topping $25 billion, but he flips NBIS from BUY to HOLD and will not add before the print, the stock already up 13-14% into it.
